title: Cycloidal drive, 11:1, 90 mm
one_line: Compact single-stage cycloidal reducer for a robot joint: 12 ring pins with rollers, two 11-lobe discs 180° out of phase on an eccentric input shaft, six output pins with rollers, real 6800/6802/6808 bearings and M3 screws.
specs: Reduction 11:1, output opposite to input (12 ring pins, 11-lobe discs)
Housing Ø90 mm; z 0–54.5 mm cover to output face, plus 16 mm input stub
Ring pins Ø4 on Ø70 circle, rollers Ø6.5
Eccentricity 1.2 mm; two 6 mm discs 180° out of phase
Disc profile: offset epitrochoid, 264-segment polyline, 0.15 mm backlash clearance
6 output pins Ø5 on Ø42 with Ø7 rollers; disc holes Ø10
Output flange Ø60, 6x M4 on Ø48, Ø16 pilot
interference: 337 pairs, 0 interferences (also 0 at input 0° / 304 pairs and 132° / 353 pairs)
poses: input 75° → output -6.82° (converged, 0 interferences; saved pose, renders)
not_verified: Gear ratio is geometric only: carried by parameter expressions, not a solver-enforced gear mate
Torque, stiffness, efficiency, backlash/lost motion, mass, bearing life not computed
Fits and tolerances are nominal CAD clearances, no fit analysis
Threads modelled as plain holes; no seals, circlips or lubrication
